mapper.select: select answer_id from biz_student_answer where student_answer = #{resource} or preview_path = #{resource} order by answer_id desc limit 1
select question_id from biz_question where file_path = #{resource} or preview_path = #{resource} order by question_id desc limit 1

select count(1) from biz_student s inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id inner join biz_lesson_assignment a on a.entry_year = s.entry_year and a.class_code = s.class_code and a.dept_id = u.dept_id inner join biz_lesson_question lq on lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id and lq.question_id = #{questionId} where s.student_id = #{studentId}
select count(1) from biz_county_exam_paper_question pq where pq.student_id = #{studentId} and (pq.file_path = #{resource} or pq.preview_path = #{resource})

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_paper_question pq inner join biz_county_exam_answer a on a.exam_id = pq.exam_id and a.student_id = pq.student_id and a.question_id = pq.question_id inner join biz_county_exam e on e.exam_id = a.exam_id where a.grader_id = #{graderId} and e.status = '2' and ifnull(e.grading_enabled, '0') = '1' and e.del_flag = '0' and (pq.file_path = #{resource} or pq.preview_path = #{resource})

select count(1) from biz_county_exam_answer a inner join biz_county_exam e on e.exam_id = a.exam_id where a.answer_id = #{answerId} and a.grader_id = #{graderId} and e.status = '2' and ifnull(e.grading_enabled, '0') = '1' and e.del_flag = '0'
